mentions.name: mt
mentions.description: An open-source knowledge base built from plain markdown notes stored locally, with scheduled review (spaced repetition) and Anki-like flashcards attached to each note. Notes sync to a private GitHub repository; the author's base has grown to over 400 markdown notes.
mentions.problem: Making knowledge from research notes stick in memory over time.
mentions.source_excerpt: Open sourcing a system where you might have notes in markdown to build a knowledge base, and review them according to a schedule, but also Anki like flash cards attached to each note.

evidence.value: Open sourcing a system where you might have notes in markdown to build a knowledge base, and review them according to a schedule, but also Anki like flash cards attached to each note.
